desc.en: The Church of the Holy Sepulchre, also known as the Church of the Resurrection, is a fourth-century church in the Christian Quarter of the Old City of Jerusalem.

desc.en: The Tower of David, also known as the Citadel, is an ancient citadel and contemporary museum, located near the Jaffa Gate entrance to the Old City of Jerusalem.
desc.es: La Torre de David es una antigua ciudadela en el Barrio Armenio de la Ciudad Vieja de Jerusalén.

places.name: Masjid Al-Aqsa

desc.en: Al-Aqsa, also known as the Haram al-Sharif, is the Islamic religious compound that encompasses the plateau of the Temple Mount, in the Old City of Jerusalem.
desc.es: Complejo de mezquitas en el Haram al-Sharif, en la Ciudad Vieja de Jerusalén.

places.admission: Access for non-Muslims is restricted and changes; check current rules before visiting.

desc.en: The Islamic Museum is a museum at Al Aqsa in the Old City section of Jerusalem.
desc.es: El Museo Islámico de Jerusalén es un museo en la Explanada de las Mezquitas en la Ciudad Vieja de Jerusalén.

desc.en: The Palestinian Museum is a museum in Birzeit, in the West Bank, Palestine, that was inaugurated on 18 May 2016.
desc.es: El Museo de Palestina es un museo en Birzeit, Estado de Palestina.
